I build cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines, and I'm honest about where the line is: I'm early in my career, I learn by making things work end to end, and then I go back and break them on purpose to see what happens.

My work sits between infrastructure and operations — Terraform that other people can read, Kubernetes that survives being poked, CI that fails loudly and early, and observability that answers "what just changed?" instead of "something is wrong." I'm drawn to the moment after a deploy, when reality arrives ahead of the plan.

01AUTOMATION WITH GUARDRAILS

Nexus

A control plane for incident response: it observes signals, diagnoses the cause, proposes an infrastructure fix, validates it in a shadow environment, passes an OPA policy gate, applies through GitOps and then verifies the recovery it promised.

Autonomy L2 — it fixes the low-risk things by itself and records why it did. Everything else waits for a human.

02DELIVERY & OPERATIONS

DevOps Infinity

The same application walked up four levels of operational maturity: a single EC2 box, then containers, then Kubernetes with autoscaling, then a full GitOps pipeline with canary delivery, observability and deliberate failure.

webhook_engine / verify.go
func Verify(body []byte, sig string) bool {
  mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)
  mac.Write(body)
  want := "sha256=" + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
  return hmac.Equal([]byte(want), []byte(sig))
}

03SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Webhook Engine

A backend built around delivery guarantees: HMAC-signed payloads, async workers, bounded retries and a dead-letter path so a slow consumer never turns into a lost event.

04 / SIGNAL → RECOVERY

The loop I keep trying to close.

Nexus, step by step. Click a stage to read what it actually does.

STAGE 01 / 08

Observe everything that moves.

Metrics, logs and events stream in from the workloads. Nothing is interpreted yet — this stage only makes sure the system can see itself, because a blind responder is just a confident responder.

  • Prometheus scrapes · OpenTelemetry traces
  • Baseline captured, not guessed
SIGNALDECISIONGUARDRAIL
CONTROL

Progressive autonomy

Recommend before mutate. The system earns the right to act.

VALIDATION

Check before apply

Proposals are tested in isolation and gated by policy first.

ACCOUNTABILITY

Record the outcome

Incident, decision and recovery signal stay inspectable.

BUILD NOTE / 01

Autonomy needs an off switch.

Nexus is deliberately staged. It observes and recommends long before it is allowed to change anything, because infrastructure that fixes itself without a paper trail is just a faster way to be confused.
